bio:
I'm Kadir Lofca. I worked on products with 2M+ users, won an IEEE award, and founded Sentzel. 

My work is an extension of my life philosophy — shape your environment, shape yourself. I curate my surroundings, build systems, and engineer habits to set myself and my work up for success. 

Apart from work, I cook hearty meals, go bouldering, play tennis, and work out. I also travel to see unique architecture. 

P.S. I'll always make time for a good conversation!
